programs.name: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGP) - MBA
programs.feeNote: 2 x the official year total of INR 11,79,295 for PGP 2026-28; excludes the INR 40,000 refundable caution deposit and mess advances.

feeSource.title: IIM Visakhapatnam PGP Program Fee - Fee Structure for PGP 2026-28 Batch
feeSource.quote: Fee Structure for PGP 2026-28 Batch ... Grand Total (in Rs.) 11,79,295 11,79,295 [1st Year, 2nd Year]. feeTotal = 2 x 11,79,295 (computed sum of the two official year totals); excludes 'one-time refundable caution deposit of Rs 40,000/-' and per-term Rs 25,000 advance for mess etc.
